summary: Augusta County, VA 60-foot steel tower on Bald Mountain in George Washington NF; 1932 plan said 50 feet; listed as removed, no date.

facts.design: 60-foot steel tower with a lookout residence cabin below
facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts marks the tower as removed; no removal date is given

events.note: The News Leader reported in September 1932 that a fifty-foot steel tower would be built on Bald Mountain; this is a plan, not a confirmed completion
Coast and Geodetic Survey described a survey mark at the apex of the lookout tower roof, so the tower stood by 1957
Registered July 30, 2018; nominated by Kristin Reynolds

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The September 1932 News Leader item describes a planned fifty-foot tower; the register gives 60 feet. These sources do not say which height was built, so the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Two sources: the FFLOS register (1) and the Forest Lookouts Virginia page (2). Height conflict (50 ft plan in 1932 vs 60 ft register) is shown in the story. Elevation 3,607 ft (1,099 m) and registry US 1725, VA 27 from the register. The NGS entry on the Forest Lookouts page is a 1957 description and does not say the tower is standing now. A Facebook group snippet from a search result says a Molpus Timberlands easement allows visits to the tower site; the fetched page showed only its title, so it is not used and access is unverified. Do not confuse with Bald Mountain Lookout Site (Nelson County), US 1715, a separate record. No staffing, fire or access information found. Two WebSearch queries were used.
